forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Mediterranean olive groves are suffering chronic thermal stress. Calm pricing overlooks fragile supply, setting up a sharp climb past $7,136.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Southern European groves face structural aridification and soil degradation. Chronic water deficits mean olive oil supply crises will recur frequently.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Persistent Mediterranean heat anomalies and water stress in alternate producers like Chile keep the supply buffer depleted, raising the probability of a sharp rally.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Severe Mediterranean heat anomalies and water shortages continue to threaten orchard yields, maintaining upward structural price pressure on olive oil.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Persistent Mediterranean heat anomalies and Southern Hemisphere deficits sustain elevated prices, despite consumer pushback.

forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Regional Middle East conflicts impact local harvests, but European recovery caps upside below extreme targets.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Consensus is at 34%. Olive oil prices dipped slightly in September, so I align closely with the market with a tiny downward tilt.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Southern European groves show gradual stabilization and consumer demand resistance caps sustained rallies above $7,136/mt.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Southern European groves face recurring heat, but ongoing recovery from extreme lows and price resistance limit another surge past $7,136.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Olive oil has plateaued while other softs run; without broader macro fund participation lifting the complex, exceeding $7,136 is an uphill climb.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: European olive oil production is rebounding from past drought lows, softening wholesale prices and rendering a rally above $7,136/mt unlikely.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: After historical price booms, supply inevitably recovers and prices settle lower. Bet on mean reversion rather than an extended rally over $7,136.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: With Mediterranean production recovering from historic lows and loosening balance sheets, sustained price surges above $7,136/mt are fundamentally unlikely.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: The Mediterranean harvest runs through early winter, swelling local mill storage. A +15% rally into March contradicts standard post-harvest price moderation.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Investments in drip irrigation and modern intensive olive groves across the Mediterranean are bringing production back.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Olive oil prices have plateaued around $6,200. Surging above $7,136 implies severe scarcity that current stabilized production trends do not support.
